## Summary
Lenses checked: correctness, silent-failure, tests, comments.

Fix the save command before merge because callers cannot rely on its success signal to know whether the report was saved.

## Changes

The pull request adds a command to save a generated report and announce its destination, plus a cleanup function that tolerates an already absent temporary report.

## Critical

- app/reports.py:8 — silent-failure — Report write failures as command failures — When the destination’s parent directory is missing, `save_report` discards the `FileNotFoundError`, prints `Report saved to {path}`, and returns `0`. — Callers can proceed expecting a report that was never created, and users get no explanation of what to correct. — Fix: Report the destination and write error, return a nonzero status before printing success, and extend `test_save_with_unavailable_destination`.
